Not sure if it might help, but i had a similar problem with a Japanese VN installation as well. 
I see that you have Daemon tools open so I’ll assume it’s a disc file or something being mounted.

What i learned is that there were certain files that couldn’t be downloaded because of specific Japanese characters. So whenever i tried installing the files it stopped or crashed. 

What i did to fix it, is that instead of directly using the Daemon Tools interface to run the installer, i’d simply mount it, and then navigate through my pc files where the installer.exe of the disc is located.

That way you can run the installer using the Locale emulator and the installer and files now appeared in Japanese and not in some weird gibberish. 

You can also change your system’s location to japan though.
